verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚ ਸਦਾਵਣਾ ਕੀੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: neechahu neech sadhaavanaa keeRee hoi na aap ganaae|

en.bdb: Ants never make themselves noticed and are known lowest among the lowly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਖਡੁ ਸਹੰਸ ਸਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag chalanaa ikat khadd saha(n)s samaae|

en.bdb: They follow the path of gurmukhs and due to their broad mindedness they live in thousands, in a small hole.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਿਅ ਸਕਰ ਦੀ ਵਾਸ ਲੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਧਰੀ ਤਿਥੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ghia sakar dhee vaas lai jithai dharee tithai chal jaae|

en.bdb: Only by smelling ghee and sugar, they reach the place where these things are kept (gurmukhs also search out he holy congregations).

verses.gurmukhi: ਡੁਲੈ ਖੰਡੁ ਜੁ ਰੇਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੰਡੂ ਦਾਣਾ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ddulai kha(n)ddu ju ret vich kha(n)ddoo dhaanaa chun chun khaae|

en.bdb: They pick up the sugar bits scattered in sand similarly as a gurmukh  cherishes the virtues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਦੇ ਭੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhira(n)gee dhe bhai jai mar hovai bhira(n)gee maar jeevaae|

en.bdb: Dying of the fear of worm bhringi the ant itself becomes bhringi and makes others also like itself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਾ ਕਛੂ ਕੂੰਜ ਦਾ ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਵਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)ddaa kachhoo koo(n)j dhaa aasaa vich niraas valaae|

en.bdb: Like the eggs of heron and tortoise, it (ant) remains detached amidst hopes.
Similarly gurmukhs also getting educated attain the pleasure fruits.
